abort.dahua_not_installed: The ha-dahua integration is not installed. Install it from HACS first, then run this setup again.

error.address_required: Please enter the camera IP address.
error.auth_failed: The camera rejected the login. Check that the security code from the QR code is correct.
error.dahua_already_configured: This camera is already set up in ha-dahua.
error.device_unreachable: Nothing responded at that address. Check the IP and that the camera is powered and on the same network.
error.drive_failed: Adding the camera through ha-dahua failed. Try adding it from the ha-dahua integration directly, then run this setup to manage it.
error.drive_timeout: ha-dahua took too long to discover the camera. Check the camera is reachable, then try again.
error.qr_missing_sc: No security code (SC) was found in that text. Paste the full QR code text from the manual.
error.qr_unrecognized: That text is not a QR payload and not a plain security code.
error.serial_missing: The camera answered but did not return a serial number.
error.sn_mismatch: The serial number in that QR code does not match this camera. Check you scanned the right camera's manual.

confirm.description: Ready to add the camera at {address} through ha-dahua. The serial number is verified against your QR code first.
confirm.title: Add camera

qr.description: Scan the QR code in the camera manual with your phone, then paste the decoded text here. The security code is extracted automatically. You can also paste just the security code.
qr.title: Paste the QR code text

user.description: Enter the camera's IP address on your local network. Tip: in your router's device list, look for the camera by its MAC address.
user.title: Find your LIXIL camera
